description: issue #874, the too-FEW direction under an active `turtle-rendering`. A bare call is the only form that can be short: the reader gathers exactly the registered default arity, so a missing argument leaves a zero-argument Call rather than a parse error — and `forward number` (`spec/commands.md:1215`) needs one. `execute()` has always raised ol-not-enough-inputs here; `check()` was silent, so this is the same two-stage disagreement as the too-many fixtures, in the opposite direction. Worth pinning separately because the derived range gate treats the bare and parenthesized forms differently by design (bare: floor only; paren: ceiling, plus the floor only when the primitive is strictly fixed-arity).
